test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only three people sit between A and F. Only two people sit to the left of A. G is not an immediate neighbour of F. G sits second to the right of C. B sits to the immediate right of D. Who sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven people, A, B, C, D, E, F and G, are sitting in a straight row, facing north.

1) Only three people sit between A and F.

2) Only two people sit to the left of A.

3) G is not an immediate neighbour of F.

4) G sits second to the right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ac0f241906bcd0ec833a8d64f325e77a31d2646f934d094ef374641915c8ef6.png] 

5) B sits to the immediate right of D.

And, E will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5706b703f6211c41aeff3db4fc92bf633b68c84332e34fa5e23b816f4ce7422d.png] 

So, 'E' sits at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
